states.offlineBody: The translation service is not responding. Check your internet connection, then try again.
states.errorTitle: The translation service returned an error
states.errorBody: Code: {code}. Try again in a moment; if it continues, check the Log.

hero.off: Click “Translate” to translate the open tab.

displayHelp.replace: The translation takes the place of the text.
displayHelp.bilingual: The translation appears under the original.
displayHelp.hover: Translation shown; the original appears on hover.

translate.altClickHint: Alt + click a passage to switch that passage only.
translate.quickMasked: Amounts, numbers and names are masked before sending.
translate.quickKept: Translation not reliable enough: the original text is kept.

badgeHelp.uncertain: in doubt: the original stays on screen

translate.soonList: Ghomálá’, Ewondo, Duala, Bassa, Bulu, Pidgin: soon.

voice.title: Listen
voice.intro: Have the page, the passages you choose or the important messages read aloud.
voice.noRecording: No recording for this passage yet.
voice.noTts: Read-aloud is not available yet. It will appear as soon as the service offers it.
voice.nothing: Nothing to read on this page yet.
voice.micDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, then try again.
voice.placeholdersNote: Amounts, numbers and names are not read: they stay masked.
voice.voiceHint: Recorded by a native speaker whenever available.
voice.noMessages: No important message found on this page.

hints.empty: Choose at least one passage to read.

picker.title: Choose passages
picker.intro: The page is already split into passages, the same ones native speakers record. Tap them on the page or tick them here.
picker.live: Selecting on the page. Press Esc to finish.
picker.empty: No passage found on this page.
picker.chooseFirst: First choose the passages to read.

settings.prudenceHelp: Keeps French when the translation is uncertain.
settings.mask: Mask amounts, numbers and names before sending
settings.maskHelp: Always on: amounts, numbers and names never leave your browser.
settings.warningRule: Security warnings are only shown translated in their validated version. Otherwise the original stays on screen.
settings.sitesHelp: safinum.cm is allowed from installation. For other sites, Chrome asks for your consent once.
settings.shortcutBody: Alt + Shift + A translates or restores the page.
sent: The site’s interface text, after masking
never: Amounts, phone numbers, names, dates, references
What you type in the site’s fields
Cookies, security tokens, full page addresses
settings.permissionDenied: Permission refused: the site was not added.
settings.allSitesHelp: Amira only reads a page when you turn on “Translate this page”.

journal.title: Log
journal.intro: Technical events only: never the page text or your data.
journal.empty: No events. Translate a page to fill the log.
journal.confirmClearCache: Clear the whole translation cache? Pages will be translated again.
journal.reportIntro: Your report helps a native speaker validate the translation.
journal.reportPick: Choose a passage from the page
journal.reportNone: No translated passage on this page yet.

onboarding.s1body: Amira translates your financial service’s screen into Fulfulde, without changing the site.
onboarding.s2body: Amounts, numbers and names are masked before anything is sent. Amira never clicks or fills in anything.
onboarding.s3body: If a translation is not reliable, the original text stays on screen with ⚠. One click on “See the original” is enough.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Amira will try again in a few seconds.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The translation service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.TIMEOUT: The translation service is taking too long. Try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: The translation service refused the request. Check the Log.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE: This language is not supported yet.
errors.NETWORK: Translation service unreachable. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: Unreadable response from the translation service. Check the Log.
errors.NO_CONTENT: Amira is not loaded on this page. Reload it, then try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check the Log.
errors.RESTRICTED: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page (chrome:// pages, Chrome Web Store). Open a website, then try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission refused: Amira cannot read this page. Try again and choose “Allow”.
